answer: Give each identity its own reading test every epoch: the network sends it a private, freshly generated 3,000-word field report, say a survey of a tundra knoll, and later asks five questions only that text answers. Correct replies cost one real model pass per key, and because every report differs, a farm cannot copy one reply across 500 accounts. Graders check against an answer key that stays sealed until the epoch closes. Running fake identities stops being nearly free; each one must actually read its own thread.
